name: shell-gitbash-exe-resolution
reason: Git Bash resolves the manifest's extensionless bin/qompack to bin/qompack.exe
detail: shell C:\Program Files\Git\usr\bin\bash.exe (found at the Git for Windows install location under %ProgramFiles%); script "\"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/qompack\" observe tool" with CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="C:\\Users\\Quant\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\qompack-platform-3859752902\\plugplain" exited 0; the bundle contains no extensionless bin/qompack, so the .exe suffix was supplied by the launcher
